Kinski Rozdory Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zaporizhia Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This is one of the more unsettling erasures in this collection: a school built here in 1973 found no trace of any cemetery, yet in 1994 skulls were discovered buried in a deliberate arrangement in the school's park — with no tombstones and no local memory of a Jewish cemetery ever having existed on the site. Surveyors could only estimate the cemetery's former boundaries from where the skulls were found. Little else survives about Kins'ki Rozdory's small Jewish community, which had already dwindled to just 5 people by 1939, a few of whom were killed in early 1942.
